name: record-failure-summary
goal: A record with hundreds of failures reads as a short, truthful summary by cause with its count, keeps every original failure readable on demand behind a disclosure, and leaves its scenarios and gallery within reach

evidence: The page of the real failed record renders its 540 failures as 540 paragraphs before the scenarios and gallery: one failed test and 539 times that a unit has no baseline. Expected: the number of failures and their causes in a few lines, every recorded failure readable behind a disclosure, the record still failed, scenarios and gallery within reach, nothing dropped from data or exports.

work/logs/stage-f-failure-summary-RED.log: the new tests/e2e/harness-failures.spec.ts with a 482-failure fixture record against the console as committed, 3 failed at desktop, tablet and mobile: no summary of the failures exists.

New units reports.function.harness-failures and reports.component.harness-harness-failures; HarnessHistory uses the component; styles in harness.css; the scale fixture gives one failed record a failure per generated unit; the console scenario gains the state failures at three viewports, captured by the evidence spec. Causes are paragraphs in a labelled group so the records stay the only items of their list, which an existing assertion counts. The feature specification says the first real run exists and failed and labels earlier statements as historical.
